note: Sibling to PINS.json, but for download.firstperson.dev's prebuilt binaries rather than git-cloned source. IMPORTANT DIFFERENCE: that server has no versioned-artifact URLs — only 'latest' (newest tagged release) and 'main' (newest compiled commit) moving pointers, plus a named release *channel* (currently 'dogwood') for the pnm/openvtc client builds. A pin here therefore records the LAST VERIFIED VERSION for drift detection, not a URL that can be re-fetched historically: advancing a pin means 'we verified a newer build', never 'roll back to an old one'. Advance only via fetch-binaries.mjs --advance <binary> --why "reason".

vta.os: linux-x86_64-only (observed; no macOS path found for this endpoint)
vta.why: Seed pinnedSha256 for the binary proven working this session (vta setup --from + cloudflared rig; ref-08 auth handshake)

pnm-server.why: The SERVER build — plaintext-config secrets, no OS keyring — the one a headless test/CI host uses (see sysop/explore/01-server-setup.md's own warning: do not substitute the client build here). DISTINCT ARTIFACT from pnm-client below — same binary name (pnm) on disk, different build. pnm has no top-level --version flag (verified), so pinnedSha256 is the only drift signal; pnm health proven working against the pinned vta build above.

pnm-client.why: The default (OS-keyring-backed) build for a developer workstation driving a VTA — not what e2e/lib/vta.js uses today (it uses pnm-server, headless). Recorded so this file also covers firstperson.dev/#downloads' listed client artifact; not yet downloaded or exercised by anything in this repo.

mediator.why: Downloaded but not yet exercised. tsp-reference/ref-08-credential-exchange found that credential-exchange/query/0.1 is NOT in vta-service's REST dispatch table (only pending-list/approve/deny are) — the query inbound path is DIDComm/TSP-messaging-only, so finishing that rung needs this mediator running and a messaging-enabled VTA (`[messaging] kind = "create_mediator"` in e2e/lib/vta.js's setup.toml), which hasn't been built yet.

mediator-setup.why: Companion to `mediator` above — its non-interactive setup wizard binary. Same status: downloaded, not yet exercised.

did-hosting-daemon.why: Downloaded but not yet exercised — e2e/lib/vta.js hosts its did:webvh did.jsonl with a plain static file server instead (per the developer tutorial's own note: 'you do not need to run a DID Daemon for this tutorial — any plain static-file host will work'). Kept pinned for when a rung needs the real daemon (key rotation, multiple DIDs, etc).

vtc.why: Downloaded but not yet exercised — no rung has stood up a Verifiable Trust Community yet.

openvtc.os: linux-x86_64 or macOS (per 02-openvtc-tui.md; also offered channel-pinned at releases/{channel}/{os}/openvtc)
openvtc.why: Not yet downloaded by anything in this repo. Recorded for when a rung drives the interactive TUI client end-to-end (persona creation, joining a community) rather than talking to a VTA's REST API directly.
